# Pin Diameter

Diameter of slender pins and posts (at least twice as tall as wide).

<figure markdown="span">
![Pin Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-pin-diameter-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Pin Diameter: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-pin-diameter-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Diameter of slender printed pins and posts.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Medium |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 3.0 mm | 2.0 mm | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.0 mm | 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "1 mm pins"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sla)<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "0.4 mm wires print 7 mm tall") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.5 mm | 0.8 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "1.5 mm")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "0.8 mm"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Slender pin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, thinner than the recommended `{target}`. Thin printed pins are weak between layers and wobble as they print. Thicken it, or print it lying down.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It will likely snap at a layer line or fail to print cleanly. Thicken it, add a fillet at its base, or press in a metal pin instead.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin pin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Thin resin pins are fragile and soften in the cleaning alcohol. Thicken it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It may not print, or will break when the supports come off. Thicken it.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin pin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Thin pins are fragile and can break off when the part is blasted clean. Thicken it.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Pin too thin (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It will likely break during depowdering. Thicken it.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
